scope: Early immutable checkpoint policy for future H3 RSI rounds
summary: Future H3 RSI training now saves an immutable LoRA candidate every 30 optimizer steps so topology and capability regression can be detected before a full epoch completes.
evidence: The pinned DiffSynth ModelLogger supports --save_steps and emits step-N.safetensors through the accelerator-safe model export path.
scripts/train_h3_identity_rsi.py validates a positive --save-steps value, defaults it to 30, forwards it to the pinned trainer, and records the checkpoint policy in the experiment manifest.
Ruff and Python bytecode compilation pass for the modified launcher.
lessons: Checkpoint frequency is part of the safety loop: shorter intervals reduce the compute spent after a candidate has already become anatomically or behaviorally unacceptable.
limitations: The already-running r3 job remains epoch-checkpointed because changing its arguments mid-run would invalidate reproducibility.
Saving a checkpoint does not evaluate or promote it; each step checkpoint still needs full held-out inference and review.
next_actions: Use step-30 tournaments in the next round only if no r3 checkpoint passes the frozen contract.
